comps.title: PSY F2P
comps.req:
If you just started playing, this lineup is completely free. All the main team characters can be obtained without spending a single gem, simply by completing the "Pirate Rumble Crew Making" panel missions found in Chopperman’s missions.

As you get characters from the "Future Replacements" section, swap them into your main team as soon as possible to improve it.
• Characters on the first row in that section have higher priority than those on the second row.
• Example: If you get the Monster Trio and Luffy G5, give priority to the Monster Trio.

You’ll receive Law and Kuzan in their unevolved forms. Don’t worry, add them to your team anyway.
• If you’re unsure which one to evolve first, I recommend evolving Law since Kuzan will eventually be replaced.

Some characters in the "Future Replacements" bench are better than some in your current main team.
• Example: Jinbe, S-Bear, Saul, and Gin can replace Eneru or Toy Soldier & Rebecca, and your team will work much better.

Priority order for limited cost 20 characters:
Jinbe → S-Bear → Saul → Gin → Toy Soldier & Rebecca → Eneru → Franky → Streussen

As soon as you get Nami, you must include 4 Straw Hat crew members in your team to fully unlock her potential.
• Best picks: Jinbe, Robin, Franky and the Monster Trio.
• If you’re missing some, use Chopper or Zoro (this one only if you have Luffy G5).
• You can also include any other cost 20 Straw Hat, such as the free ones you get from completing PKA for the first time.
